evidence.topology: one host; three original binaries online, fourth absent then original binary joins; same four-validator set

phase_timings.phase: propagate beyond global capacity before TTL
online quorum finality (offline node excluded from observation, not validator set)
fourth node archive catchup without wallet resubmission

evidence.phase_timing_scope: wall-clock intervals including HTTP observation and fixture checks; not production latency or TPS

apfl_transport.scope: application codec work, not unique transactions or TLS delivery

stage_profile.scope: process lifetime inclusive wall time; overlapping/nested phases; non-atomic snapshot; not CPU time or consensus evidence

ingress_before_ttl.physical_gpu_verification_scope: local driver-reported bound resource after completed diagnostic dispatch; not hardware/remote attestation; false when unobserved
ingress_before_ttl.integer_observation_scope: AOEM Vulkan non-padding predictions in completed candidates, including stale; fees/ordered repairs remain AOEM CPU; local diagnostics are not business commitments

gossip_repair.scope: local omitted-recipient repair; not remote or durable receipt

rpc_authentication.scope: local signature checks, not unique transactions or finality

ingress_before_ttl.receipt_query_scope: hash only: recent 65536 entries; optional block height: verified durable archive

propagation_batch_counts.scope: local queue admission, excludes repeated repair offers; not peer receipt
